properties.description: Pins the shared reading of "arrived" from both sides, on in-memory designs: a delivered requirement, a finding closed by a change or by its valid_to, a finding answered by an accepted Decision, a finding that led to a change, decision or requirement, a ChangeEvent and a DesignRule all clear unresolved_setup; an accepted requirement not yet delivered, a finding only an idea mitigates, a refuted cause and a finding-to-finding link whose later finding is still open (C4) still raise. The defect message names INVALIDATES, valid_to, MITIGATES, CAUSES and TRIGGERS for a finding and delivered and met for a requirement. The promotion detector and the follow-through rule agree on a fixture of 19 target kinds, and differ only in the two clauses each rule's own definition adds.
